status: PROTOCOL CORRECTION REQUIRED 2026-10-04; prior run invalid because F1 checkpoint tolerance was 150 ms rather than registered 100 ms; rerun from scratch after corrected clean preflight
purpose: Test whether the existing WSST representation can directly predict Q/R/S/T events on unseen subjects before implementing an event-conditioned waveform decoder.

arms.E0: Frozen matched Chen-TCN waveform-derived Q/R/S/T readout under the same prominence evaluator; no retraining or reselection.
arms.E1: StructuredEventREM: incumbent WSSTStem plus incumbent five-block TCN plus four-channel Q/R/S/T heatmap head. No waveform decoder, interval loss, range attention or native RCG.

single_changed_variable: Direct four-fiducial event supervision/readout instead of deriving Q/R/S/T from a reconstructed waveform.
targets: Training/validation/test ECG independently delineated by the Gate-0-fixed NeuroKit2 0.2.12 prominence algorithm; Gaussian heatmaps at Q/R/S/T with sigma 4 samples. Test ECG is evaluation-only.
loss: Unweighted binary cross entropy with logits, averaged equally over the four event channels. No waveform, MR-STFT, interval, ordering or dynamic task weighting term.
checkpoint_selection: Validation-only macro mean of Q/R/S/T F1 at 100 ms; ties resolved by lower macro localization MedAE. Test split is opened once after checkpoint freeze.
readout: Per-channel sigmoid; fixed peak threshold 0.5 and minimum same-fiducial distance 200 ms; order-preserving matching within 150 ms. No test-derived threshold.

promotion_gate_locked_before_training.accuracy: E1 improves at least 3 of 4 localization MedAE metrics relative to E0 and reduces their unweighted macro mean by at least 10%.
promotion_gate_locked_before_training.fold_consistency: The macro localization MedAE improves on at least 2 of 3 folds.
promotion_gate_locked_before_training.coverage: For every promoted event, E1 matched-event coverage is no more than 0.03 below E0.
promotion_gate_locked_before_training.ordering: Predicted complete-beat Q<R<S<T violation rate is no greater than 0.05.
promotion_gate_locked_before_training.decision: All clauses pass -> authorise design of E1-vs-event-conditioned-decoder interaction gate. Any clause fails -> close the structured-event rescue route without 11-fold expansion.

constraints: No Shape-200, calibration, GT timing at inference, native-RCG fusion, delay warp or Route-C assembly.
No test metric influences threshold, checkpoint, architecture or promotion definitions.
Formal launch requires committed code, clean tracked worktree, registry commit/branch, smoke test and unique atomic output path.
